reviews.title: Ok app, Too many changes
reviews.text: I’ve had Blessed app since December 2023 and I’ve seen the updates that have taken place over the past two years. I really do believe they have took a lot of user’s concerns into consideration and made improvements. I don’t often times use my app, but I do use it for reading and listening to the Bible and possibly listening to a sermon or two. I personally do not like the update with the daily walk (morning and evening prayers). I don’t like  how music plays as I read it. Maybe there can be an option to turn the music off while reading. It’s very different from when I first started using this app, and I personally prefer the older morning and evening devotionals. I feel like there are just too many steps or too many check marks to reach the end. Along with this I don’t like how it gives a 3 minute timer when initially opening the Bible each day. I made the mistake of opening the Bible on this app to follow the scripture at my church and it made a noise when the 3 minutes were up. My phone was on vibrate, but the app made the noise to say I accomplished another goal and streak. I was so embarrassed by the noise that I’m really considering finding another app and canceling my subscription. I’m also sick of getting random messages and friend requests from people. I get that everyone wants to be a part of a community, but this isn’t it! Adding people shouldn’t even be an option, let alone sending messages. I was once a fan, but now I’m highly disappointed.

reviews.title: Cancelled subscription but still being billed!
reviews.text: I’m extremely annoyed. I cancelled my subscription after having it for over a year. It’s still causing a billing issue on my Apple account because I didn’t pay a month prior. If I no longer use it, I refuse to pay for it. I have not had this issue with any other app I no longer wanted to use. I’ve always been able to cancel without a problem and move forward. This app is causing so many issues, which is angering me. I see many others are having an issue with canceling and still being charged as well. I really did like the app at first but the ads and paying a subscription is ridiculous. I hate scams and money hungry apps!
